summary.text: Joe Powers is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 155 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Matt Hatchett.
A communications consultant, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that education, rural health care and Medicaid expansion should be state priorities.

paragraphs.text: Joe Powers earned a high school diploma from Stephens County High School and graduated from Gwinnett Technical College in 2007.
He also attended Southern New Hampshire University and Piedmont College, and his career experience includes working as a communications consultant.
Powers received all 3,224 votes in the Democratic primary for District 155 on May 19, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a "center leaning, fiscally conservative Democrat" and listed education, Medicaid expansion and rural health care among his priorities.
He also said Georgia should stop giving corporate tax breaks "with no consequences" and favored transparent agreements with businesses and strong local development authorities.
